Frederick Goldman Rat Quest Completed

EventCrestfallHighreach
Type
Event
Region
Crestfall
Location
Highreach
Date
0496-03-01

What Happened

  • The party cleared Lord Frederick Goldman's cellar of rats, killing all doppelrats but damaging about 20% of the wine collection
  • The guild refused to pay for mutated rat tails but paid out for the 2 doppelrat tails
  • The party convinced the butler to send the repair bill to Jon Brightman at the Wizard's Guild, who sent it back to the Adventurers Guild, who the party then convinced to cover it

Key Takeaways

  • The party completed their first quest but made a messy impression on the Goldman household
  • The Adventurers Guild covered the bill — but the party's reputation took a small hit
